F01.value: 2312 gray-level images (filtered to 2136 images after removing non-conforming images), 10 classes, GitHub link provided
F01.evidence: GC10-DET is a dataset of steel strip surface defects collected in a real-world manufacturing environment, with a total of 2312 gray-level images.

F02.value: 8:1:1 random split of 2136 filtered images into training set (1709 images), validation set, and test set
F02.evidence: The dataset was split randomly into three subsets: training set, validation set, and test set in the ratio of 8:1:1 to ensure optimal training results.

F09.evidence: To enhance the efficiency of the defect recognition model training, the 1709 raw images in the training set were resized to 640×640.

F10.evidence: The batch size was set to 32 and the training process was conducted for a total of 200 epochs.
